features.title: Complete
features.f1Desc: Create route sheets, assign shipments to drivers and manage the entire dispatch flow from a single panel. Reassign in real time based on availability and coverage area.
features.f2Desc: Track each driver's location on a live map. Share a public tracking link so your customers can see their shipment status without calling.
features.f3Desc: Automatically calculate driver, branch and client commissions. Define percentages, fixed amounts and custom concepts. Generate settlement PDFs with one click.
features.f4Desc: Sync orders from Mercado Libre and Tiendanube automatically. Update shipment statuses on the source platform without manual intervention.
features.f5Desc: Scan QR codes to receive, transfer and deliver packages. Record every movement with full traceability from reception to delivery.
features.f6Desc: Generate QR code labels, dispatch tags and proof of delivery (EPOD) automatically. Print in batch or one by one.
features.f7Desc: Dashboard with key metrics: shipments per day, revenue, driver performance, demand prediction and productivity analysis by branch.
features.f8Desc: Drivers manage their routes, confirm deliveries with photo and signature, record COD payments and report incidents from their phone.
